description: Source code implementing functions for netlink socket communication and wireless interface management using libnl library.

methods.name: unl_init
methods.description: Initializes the unl structure by allocating a netlink socket.

methods.name: unl_genl_init
methods.description: Initializes the generic netlink connection for a given family name.

methods.name: unl_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the unl structure.

methods.name: unl_genl_msg
methods.description: Creates a new netlink message for a specific command.

methods.name: unl_genl_request
methods.description: Sends a netlink request with callback handling.

methods.name: request_single_cb
methods.description: Callback for handling single netlink message responses.

methods.name: unl_genl_request_single
methods.description: Sends a request expecting a single reply.

methods.name: no_seq_check
methods.description: Sequence check callback that always returns OK.

methods.name: unl_genl_loop
methods.description: Receives netlink messages in a loop until done.

methods.name: unl_genl_multicast_id
methods.description: Retrieves multicast group ID for a given group name.

methods.name: unl_nl80211_phy_lookup
methods.description: Looks up the physical device index by name.

methods.name: unl_nl80211_wdev_to_phy
methods.description: Converts a wireless device index to a physical device index.
